responsibility: Implements the Thumb-2-specific machine-description patterns and transforms for the Arm backend. It provides Thumb-2 RTL splits, conditional-execution sequences, peepholes, low-overhead loop support, clear-multiple and CMSE-related instructions, wide-shift helpers, and many arithmetic/control-flow patterns whose encoding or expansion differs from ARM or Thumb-1, making it the Thumb-2-specific lowering layer within the Arm machine description.
